evaluation.side_info_rule: 0 B for uniform/no_rs, one byte per channel for sorted methods
evaluation.mask_protocol: one master mask per (batch, seed, rate) shared by all methods; smaller schemes use its first columns

insights: Based on 3 channel seed(s); 5000 images per seed. All gains below are paired per seed against the baseline (same packet losses), so they carry no luck-of-the-draw advantage.
Break-even: the best protected method overtakes `uniform` from about erasure_rate = 0.32.

Low-loss penalty: even the best method is 0.38 dB below `uniform` at erasure_rate = 0.3 (two_tier_50_50@energy). This is the block-length effect of a single large RS block, which tiered coding gives up.
Peak gain: +1.21 dB at erasure_rate = 0.45 by three_tier_25_25_50@energy (95% CI ±0.01, significant).
Importance sources ranked by their best scheme's mean gain over erasure_rate >= 0.35: energy +0.89 dB, oracle +0.87 dB.
Share of the reference ranking's gain captured: energy 102%. A share above 100% means that source allocated protection better than the reference.
Worst-case images at erasure_rate = 0.4: 5th-percentile PSNR 22.25 dB (three_tier_25_50_25@energy) vs 20.98 dB (uniform).
Worst-case images at erasure_rate = 0.5: 5th-percentile PSNR 20.08 dB (three_tier_25_25_50@energy) vs 19.59 dB (uniform).
Seed sensitivity: std across channel seeds stays below 0.3 dB everywhere.
`uniform` shows its steepest fall (-2.14 dB) between erasure_rate = 0.3 and 0.35 -- its cliff.
